home.faq.title: FAQ
home.faq.a1: Yahoo real-time search only indexes tweets from the past ~30 days. Older data is unavailable.
home.faq.a2: No. Completely free, no registration or login required. Just enter a username.
home.faq.q3: What if search results are inaccurate?
home.faq.a3: Yahoo search relies on public tweet indexing. Private accounts or deleted tweets may result in incomplete data.
home.faq.q4: Why are some users missing from results?
home.faq.a4: Only @mentions are counted, not replies, quotes, or retweets. If interactions are mainly through replies, they may not be counted.
home.faq.a5: Yes. Generated circles are saved with a unique ID and can be viewed anytime.
home.faq.a6: Twitter avatars are loaded via proxy. Occasional failures due to network issues are normal — just refresh later.
home.scoring.title: 📊 Scoring Rules
home.scoring.mentionDesc: The only scoring dimension, ranked directly by mention count
home.scoring.daysDesc: Only counts public tweets from the past 30 days
home.scoring.freeDesc: Via Yahoo Japan search, no keys needed
home.scoring.note: Only counts @mention frequency. Does not distinguish interaction direction. No time decay. Great for quickly seeing who mentioned you most recently.
